title: We Never Learn
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High school senior Nariyuki Yuiga, from a poor family whose father has died, can win a full university scholarship only by tutoring three classmates who are geniuses in one field and hopeless in the subjects they want to study. As he helps them, they and two older women, their teacher Mafuyu Kirisu and the ronin Asumi Kominami, develop feelings for him; the series ends with five separate endings, one for each girl.
life_message: It holds up following the path you love even when it is not the one you are gifted for, and helping others toward their dreams.
